description:
At NetBox Labs, our mission is to make it easier to build and manage complex networks. As a product company, we do that by developing innovative software for network professionals delivered on-premises and in the cloud.

We're hiring our first Senior Product Marketing Manager. The NetBox Labs platform is built around NetBox, the open source infrastructure system of record, and helps network and infrastructure teams model, see, act on, and govern everything they run. You'll own product marketing for a major area of that platform, from positioning and launches through sales enablement and competitive intel.

Reporting to the Director of Product Marketing, you'll work closely with the Product and Marketing teams, Sales, Solutions Engineering, and Customer Success. You'll own the story for your area and run our core product marketing programs for it: positioning, competitive intel, launches, enablement, market insights, and customer evidence.

This role is ideal for a product marketer who has sold and marketed technical products, gets close enough to a product to explain it with confidence, and wants to own a product area as the first hire on a growing team.

What you'll do

  • Own positioning and messaging for your area by persona and use case, inside the NetBox Labs platform narrative.

  • Plan and run launches for your area end to end, from launch messaging to field enablement, working with Product on timing and tiering.

  • Equip the field to win deals with enablement briefs and decks, demo narratives, objection handling, and training for account executives and solutions engineers.

  • Own competitive intel for your area, including battlecards, win/loss input, and live deal support in a market where buyers compare tools head to head.

  • Bring market insights from customer interviews, win/loss reviews, and field feedback back to Product to shape the roadmap and packaging for your products.

  • Find and build customer evidence, such as stories, references, and proof points from the accounts that use your products.

  • Explain the value of your coverage area to customers and the community in blog posts, webinars, demos, and talks.

What we're looking for

  • 5+ years in product marketing, or in product marketing plus a close neighbor such as product management, solutions engineering, or technical marketing, at B2B software companies that sell to technical buyers.

  • A track record of launching products end to end and enabling sales teams to win with them.

  • Clear, precise writing, and the range to tell the same story to an engineer and to an executive.

  • Experience building competitive programs and supporting live deals in a competitive market.

  • Comfort working remotely at a fast-moving startup, where you build the process as you go.

Bonus qualifications

  • Technical depth to follow an architecture conversation and translate it into customer value.

  • A background in networking, network automation, or infrastructure, as a practitioner, a solutions engineer, or a marketer of those products.

  • Experience with open source projects and communities, or with marketing an open core product.

  • Hands-on experience with NetBox or other network and infrastructure tools.

  • Experience using AI tools in your day-to-day work.

  • Work samples you can share, such as writing, decks, videos, or demos.

If you meet most of this and the work excites you, we'd like to hear from you.

About NetBox Labs:

NetBox Labs helps companies build and manage complex networks. We help customers accelerate network automation by delivering open, composable products and supporting the network automation community.

NetBox Labs is the commercial steward of open source NetBox, the world’s most popular network source of truth, and Orb, the next-generation open source network observability platform. Our products include NetBox Enterprise, a fully supported self-managed NetBox with advanced features, and NetBox Cloud, a secure, scalable, and reliable SaaS edition of NetBox.

NetBox powers thousands of companies, and NetBox Labs is backed by investment from Notable Capital (formerly GGV), Grafana Labs CEO Raj Dutt, Flybridge, IBM, Salesforce Ventures, and Mango Capital.

Our culture and values:

  • We own and solve problems with high attention to detail.

  • Our open source contributors, users, customers & team are all part of our community. When our community wins, we win.

  • We prioritize simplicity and think twice before adding complexity

  • Clear communication helps keep our team aligned and collaborating smoothly.

NetBox Labs is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We believe diverse teams build better software, and we welcome applicants of every race, color, religion, gender identity, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, and veteran status. If you need accommodation at any point in the process, just let us know.
